zh-CN.summary: Monet 2.2.8 增强工作台调度、复制与图片浏览能力，加入自定义主题，并修复空闲会话状态、跨会话选区和 Codex 历史附件加载。

items.title: 运行时输入队列控制
items.detail: 会话运行期间可查看、追加和管理待发送输入，当前轮排队内容会立即出现在时间线中。

items.title: 快速选择工作台目标
items.detail: 从档案等入口可直接选择已有工作台，或创建目标并打开会话，减少多步跳转。

items.title: 语义复制与图片操作
items.detail: 会话内容支持纯文本、Markdown、富文本和完整格式复制，并补充图片预览与快捷操作。

items.title: AI 生成自定义主题
items.detail: 可通过自然语言生成和验证自定义主题，同时保留内置主题作为安全回退。

items.title: 工具过程与图片堆叠浏览
items.detail: 工具调用按最新状态紧凑呈现；图片按出现顺序展开并靠右定位，支持横向滚动、独立展开和按需挂载，最新图片始终位于堆叠顶层。

items.title: 会话交互细节
items.detail: 优化档案中的工作台入口、排队输入反馈和完整复制的 HTML 保真度。

items.title: 空闲会话状态恢复
items.detail: 修复已停止或长期空闲的会话仍显示运行中、却无法中断的问题，并恢复正确的操作状态。

items.title: 跨会话选区残影
items.detail: 点击空白区域或按 Escape 会完整清除原生文字与列表符号选区，并阻止选区残留扩散到其他常驻会话。

items.title: Codex 历史图片附件加载
items.detail: 使用稳定的内容定位恢复 App Server 与本地会话记录之间的图片映射，修复历史附件提示资源不存在。

en-US.summary: Monet 2.2.8 expands Workbench routing, copying, and image browsing, adds custom themes, and fixes idle-session state, cross-session selection artifacts, and Codex historical attachments.

items.title: Runtime input queue controls
items.detail: View, append, and manage pending input while a session is running; queued content for the current turn now appears in the timeline immediately.

items.title: Quick Workbench target selection
items.detail: Choose an existing Workbench or create a target and open a session directly from archive and related entry points.

items.title: Semantic copying and image actions
items.detail: Copy session content as plain text, Markdown, rich text, or full fidelity, with additional image previews and quick actions.

items.title: AI-generated custom themes
items.detail: Generate and validate custom themes from natural-language requests while retaining built-in themes as a safe fallback.

items.title: Tool progress and stacked image browsing
items.detail: Tool calls present their latest state compactly; images expand chronologically, align to the latest item, scroll horizontally, use a separate expand control, and mount on demand with the newest image on top.

items.title: Session interaction details
items.detail: Improves the archive Workbench action, queued-input feedback, and HTML fidelity in full-format copies.

items.title: Idle session state recovery
items.detail: Fixes stopped or long-idle sessions remaining marked as running while no interrupt action is available, restoring the correct controls.

items.title: Cross-session selection artifacts
items.detail: Clicking blank space or pressing Escape now clears native text and list-marker selection completely and prevents residual highlights from reaching other mounted sessions.

items.title: Codex historical image attachments
items.detail: Uses stable content-based lookup across App Server and local session records, fixing historical attachments that reported a missing asset.
